# Washington Trails Association

> > Washington Trails Association (WTA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to hiking trail advocacy, maintenance, and outdoor recreation access across Washington State's public lands.

WTA works with partners including the U.S. Forest Service, Washington State Parks, and North Cascades National Park to maintain trails, advocate for trail access, and build a vibrant hiking community through volunteer programs and the Trail Action Network.

## Key Topics

- Washington Trails Association (WTA)
- Trail advocacy and access
- U.S. Forest Service partnerships
- Washington State Parks
- North Cascades National Park
- Mount Rainier National Park
- Trail maintenance and volunteer work
- Outdoor recreation policy
- Hiking community engagement
- Public lands stewardship
- Trail Action Network
- Forest Service collaboration
- Seasonal trail staff programs
